rule: Replayed learning cannot apply to production recommendations until a named human approval state, reason, rollback note, and blocked payment route are visible.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody approval can apply shared learning.
approval_principles: A replay remains simulated until a named approver is visible.
Approval state must be explicit before recommendation weights can change.
Approval reason must explain why the replay is safe to apply.
Approval timestamp must be stored with the fixture and replay delta.
Rollback state must be visible beside every approved replay.
Blocked payment routes remain blocked even when the replay is approved.
Tenant-private memory and anonymized aggregate learning stay separated by the same approval gate.

role_approval_gates.approval_reason: lead response and proof freshness confirmed
market readiness and proof density confirmed

acceptance: Marketplace shows the human approval replay gate after the boundary audit replay console.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show approver, reason, state, rollback, and blocked route.
Copy output includes fixture id, replay delta, approval state, approval reason, timestamp, rollback, and blocked route.
Build Phase includes the v168 Human Approval Replay Gate contract.
Static check fails if the approval gate UI, contract, JSON model, or cache-bust token is missing.
No blocked payment approval route can become shared learning in phase one.
